QR (album) | QR (also known as Quiet Riot, Quiet Riot IV, or QR IV ) is the sixth studio album released in 1988 by the American heavy metal band Quiet Riot. Shortino's hiring was not the only line-up change, as Chuck Wright had quit the band and was replaced by Sean McNabb.
